rectangle.label: Rectangle
rectangle.tooltip: Drag corner to corner: walls round it, or filled. One wide, it is a wall. A door gap opens in the side facing you.

circle.label: Circle
circle.tooltip: Drag from the centre out: a ring of walls, or filled, up to 31 across.

stairs.label: Stairs
stairs.tooltip: Drag from the foot toward the top: a block up a step, as wide as the drag, with 3 blocks of headroom kept above each step.
